scope: Rotor end bell as one connected solid: a six-spoke web seated on the measured hub flange, and an outer rim carrying the magnets on its bore above the web.
status: Primeform proposal, not OEM or CubeMars geometry.

features.spoked_web: r 22.25 to 40.5 mm, z -1.75 to 0.25 mm, 6 ribs of 4.0 mm
features.magnet_band: r 40.5 to 42.4 mm, z 0.25 to 11.5 mm (11.25 mm long), seated in the rim bore with no interference

open: The joint to the hub is undefined: no fit, key, screw or bond is specified.
The magnet radial band (r 40.5 to 42.4 mm) does not match the arcuate slots in the source housings (r 41.766 to 43.236 mm), so rotor radial placement is unproven.
